adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, `handleNewBooking` accumulates additional host calendars via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. However when persisting the Booking, it only connects the first entry: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (handleNewBooking.ts ~1871). All later flows that rebuild `evt` from the DB (e.g. confirm.handler/editLocation/webhooks/paypal-webhook) only read `booking.destinationCalendar` (a single relation) and wrap it as a 1-element array, so the additional collective hosts’ destination calendars are lost on those paths, leading to missing calendar events for those hosts in confirmation/payment/reschedule flows.
